scene black
The termite queen has tasked us with chewing through your deathbed.
We’ll please her, lick her body clean, ensure we keep our young fed.
To starve and die a lonely death with dirt around us always,
It feels a bit like heaven here. Or maybe just a hallway.
scene colorbars
there is nothing more liminal than this
scene tsuneyidergzyafd1
Tsuneyo Tojo glanced down at a tomato, recalling a story she once heard about how humans thought they were poisonous for a long fucking time until some wack job ate one and realized they weren’t.
Now, people eat tomatoes all the time. She wasn’t particularly a fan, though.
Yes, they could be incorporated into several specific types of ramen, but she had yet to create or a discover a recipe in which they did not overpower everything else.

Today, she would try again. For there was no one here at all. No one here at all. It was just her and a tomato. It was her and a tomato and a knife. It was red. Like her nails. Like the hair of the ghost who raped her.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd2
Surely that was just a dream, though. And while it may have felt real, it defied all logic and happened between her and a dead woman.
It felt strange to her — wanting to experience that again. But it did feel new. And it made her want to try new things. Hence the tomato.
But Tsuneyo Tojo could not fuck a tomato, no. Not before marriage. And Tomato Tojo didn’t sound good. Nor did Tsuneyo Tomato. Actually, that one wasn’t that bad. But still, no.
: This is beginning to become a burden. Perhaps I should speak to a doctor?
: I am a doctor.
: And now the tomato is speaking to me. How predictably unpredictable.
: What seems to be the problem, Ramen Girl?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd3
: Well, Mr. Mato, I’ve been experiencing strange hallucinations lately. Every day. And I’m hearing things too. Sometimes, both at once.
: But how does that make you feel?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd4

: I don’t feel much at all. But I believe it makes me crazy. And I worry about what will happen if I mention it to anyone else as I am already an exhibitionist. I do not wish to further burden those I care about.
: Do you enjoy being an exhibitionist?
: Not particularly. Nor do I think I am very good at it as it only happened once and was entirely unintentional.
: Have you figured out why such a thing has happened yet?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd1
: No...I have not. But I have an idea.
: Why don’t you tell me all about it? No one else is here. You can pretend I’m any old customer.
: This is meant to be a place for others to voice their worries to me. I will tarnish the sanctity of Tojo Ramen if I attempt to do the same.
: Maintaining the “sanctity” of this place is important to you then?
: It is my only duty. I would leave everyone and everything else behind for it if I needed to.
: Sounds pretty serious. Have you tried getting fucked?
: That seems rather inappropriate for a tomato to say to a human. Let alone a doctor tomato.
: I just think you’d feel a lot better if you got fucked.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd5
: Just do it. You know for a fact that guy you’re interested in would help you out. And he’s already doing it with your friends.
: Why are you so scared, Ramen Girl? Just be more like them. That’s what they want. That’s what you want. And it would feel good too.
: I will not be tempted by a tomato. No matter how logical and blunt that tomato is.
: It felt good, right? That dead lady’s fingers inside of you.
: Life is full of things that feel good. But feeling good alone doesn’t mean something is good for you.
: You mean like eating ramen?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd6
: That’s it. Prepare to die.
: Mean-spirited tree girl! I have entered your working establishment.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd7
: 二人で。
: Ah. Forgive me for not immediately noticing. Welcome to Tojo Ramen. You may seat yourselves. Please take a look at the menu and let me know if you have any questions.
: Understood. You’ve brought your own drawing equipment today and will not require mine. This saves me approximately 50 yen. I am eternally grateful.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd8
: Nao-chan has informed me that she visited this place with Friendburger Friendman and that you were very kind to her. I did not believe it.
: But I rejected this disbelief and decided that floppy wet breadstrips would give her a mouthsmile. Please do not turn her reverse-frown upside right.
: Here at Tojo Ramen, we serve only the most mid-tier ingredients. Anything higher taints the authenticity of ramen. I can assure you that you will leave as satisfied as always.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd9
: Are you the only human who does the workjob in this house of soup?
: That is correct. And again, we are not looking for assistance. But I thank you for your interest regardless.
scene black
: Now please, sit. I will not be able to live with myself if my customers are uncomfortable.
: Come, Nao-chan! Your book of colors will be more colorable upon this lengthy wooden noodlebed!
scene tsuneyidergzyafd10
: May I interest either of you two in a tomato free of charge?
: Don’t you dare.
: What is “tomato?”
: Oh. You mean a savory nonapple. In what manner will its preparations be made?
: Any way you like. I just want an excuse to kill it.
: The nonapple lives?
: And speaks as well?!
: She can hear it too?
: Nao-chan believes the red sphere of flavor to be alive for some reason, yet none of its vibrations find my overcomplicated hearing orifices.
: Interesting. Has she recently hallucinated sexual intercourse with a ghost as well?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd11
: Have you, Nao-chan?
: It does not appear that she has.
: How unfortunate. It appears that I must continue to bask in uncertainty and unease then. Have you decided on your order yet?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd12
: Tori shio ramen, multiplied by two to match the amount of bodies Nao-chan and I have combined.
: I’m sorry, but that will not be possible today. My father is still unwell.
: Then two servings of whichever soup contains the least amount of bugs.
: That would be all of them.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd13
: What do you think, Nao-chan?
: I agree. And in regard to the nonapple?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd14

: House chashumen, multiplied by two to match the amount of bodies Nao-chan and I have combined. We will also have one clear cylinder of ocean blood and a less clear cylinder of maternal bovine juice.
: And one tomato, diced viciously into small cubes. Yes?
: No. Nao-chan does not want to witness a death at the eating counter.
: Thank you, little girl. Your name will go down in history once word of your good deed reaches the Eternal Vine.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd15
: You will sleep out here once the shop has closed...and hopefully rot by morning’s first light.
: I’m sorry. But this debatably fruitful vegetable has scorned me.
: There was no “scorn” at all. All I did was recommend a nice, healthy beef injection to ease the pain of growing up and all the terrible things that makes us feel. It’s an entirely human response.
: Beef injection? Is that supposed to make the meat come quicker?
: S-SEX?!?!
scene tsuneyidergzyafd16
: Why do you know more human terms than me all of a sudden?! I have been doing the practices for very long! I should be the smart one!
: Of course I have the embarrassment, Nao-chan! You should remember what happened on the hallowed ween!
: No! You look like a nonapple! I look like a regular human female! Because that is what I am!
scene tsuneyidergzyafd17
: Something seems strange all of a sudden.

: If there is a certain topic or issue you wish to discuss to ease your mind, you may do so. Tojo Ramen is not just a house of soup, it is a house of secrets. And everything you say within these walls shall stay here forever.
: But...doing the talking will only make the shames bigger! Make your colors, Nao-chan! This is adultspeak!
: If you believe that talking will only deepen your issues, it is also fine to sit here in silence. Your dinner shall be ready momentarily. And in the event that you change your mind-
: I was a cat!
: What?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd18
: I went “nyaa nyaa” and licked my paws to clean my face...
: I understand now why you were embarrassed to speak of this. I was unaware that you were such a dreadful pervert.
: That...That’s not...all, though...I...
: I...did my first sex...
: With a ghost?
: With a...human...a man...
: I see. One day, I will find someone to relate to.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd19
: It felt...really good! I understand now why it’s such a common act between all species! But now my chest muscle goes DUNDUNDUNDUNDUN whenever the memory attacks my brain!
: I can’t...stop thinking about it!
: No! You take too long in the resting room!
scene tsuneyidergzyafd17
: I can understand your concerns and why you would feel this way.
: I, too, recently had my first sexual experience. And while it was not exactly what I imagined it would be, I’d be lying if I said I imagined much at all to begin with.
: F-Finally! A relation I possess with the mean-spirited tree girl! She understands more than Nao-chan! She knows the pain! She wants kittens too!
: It’s a terrifying thing, isn’t it? To feel so much at once. I can understand now how one would get lost in it.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd20
: If you do not mind me contributing to the conversation in a manner slightly above just listening, I’d like to mention my upbringing in an effort to connect and further relate. May I proceed?
: Yes! Speak to me about your sex! I want to learn more!
: If it’s about learning, I’m afraid I won’t be of much help. It wasn’t until recently that I’d learned about sex at all.
scene tsuneyidergzyafd17
: Growing up, my entire life was ramen. Cooking. How to procure and prepare ingredients. The knowledge of anything else seemed entirely unnecessary when this was always meant to be my life.
: And while I’d known that animals reproduced via mating, I was left with only assumptions when it came to humans.
: I knew not of attraction...or what it meant to want someone on an instinctive level. But now that I do know, I am terrified. How can just wanting something feel so powerful?
: Do you feel that same fear? Has experiencing it in reality amplified it? Or weakened it?
: How can I make this go away?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd21
: I would also like to know the answer to that question...
: Doing the kiss move already made my lungs feel like they were full of bugs, but this is nineteen times worse.
: It felt like I was...doing a bad thing. That it was too good to be a good thing. But now my human life is becoming strange and the me inside of me keeps telling me to do it more.
: Who is this “you inside of you” that you speak of?
: It’s me, but not me. The words I have to explain it seem wrong.
: Does it force you to do things? Things you wouldn’t imagine otherwise? Things that seem powerful and right in the moment, but only because they are part of an illusion?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd22
: Yes! That is exactly the feeling! You are correct!
scene tsuneyidergzyafd23
: Have they ever taken your clothes off and sent you outside to deliver a message to the sky and all who live beneath it?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd24
: So specific! No! Mine just make me want to mate with Friend! Forever and ever and ever! And ever and ever and then longer after that!
scene tsuneyidergzyafd25
: I see. Then perhaps the voices we hear are different. Especially if you were not able to catch the words of Tom Mato, MD.
: Perhaps! But-
scene tsuneyidergzyafd26
: Nao-chan?
: What is mattering?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd27
: If she is concerned about the cleanliness of the broth vats, I can assure her that they are perfectly fine and have been boiling nonstop for decades now.
: That doesn’t appear to be the mattering. She thinks that there’s something behind you.
: Yes. Those would be the broth vats. Which are perfectly clean and have been boiling nonstop for decades now.
: She says what’s behind you doesn’t involve soup at all. She calls him- what was the name again, Nao-chan?
: Tenchou-sama!
: Tenchou-sama?
scene tsuneyidergzyafd28
: But there’s nothing-
scene tsuneyidergzyafd29
: Wha-
